display.name: Bollinger Fade
display.description:
bollinger(20, 2σ) on 5m sol. close above the upper band we sell it, below the lower we buy it, inside the bands we hold nothing and quote.

tickets start around ten dollars — this is a first deposit, not an allocation. small size, no leverage games, and you can pull your whole balance in one go.
display._x_note: X linking needs a real OAuth click-through per vault (getXChallenge -> authorize on X -> setVaultXConnection). Not automatable; see README.
